decision: Remove contradictory carbon proxies for retained historic products; keep their thermal definitions and unknown carbon factors. Use existing intervention LCA accounting, not invented historical emissions.

retained_stock.name: Historic coke ash fill
retained_stock.reason: No suitable historic coke-ash carbon source was found; expanded clay is a different manufactured material and its former proxy is removed.

retained_stock.name: Soft wood-fibre board
retained_stock.reason: Hardboard is a different board grade; its former proxy is removed. A better modern wet-process softboard EPD candidate is retained in the evidence material, pending compatible carbon indicators.

retained_stock.name: Wood Shavings
retained_stock.reason: Particleboard includes pressing and binders absent from loose historic shavings; its former proxy is removed. A modern shavings-insulation EPD candidate is retained in the evidence material, pending compatible carbon indicators.

better_candidates.name: STEICO wet-process wood-fibre insulation boards
better_candidates.applicability: A better softboard product-family candidate than hardboard; still a modern proxy for historic material.

better_candidates.name: Baufritz HOIZ wood-shavings insulation
better_candidates.applicability: Actual loose shavings product with modern soda/whey treatment; closer product form than particleboard, but density remains a review.

metric_limitation: The candidate EPDs publish EN 15804+A2 GWP indicators including biogenic storage. Their negative GWP-total values are not interchangeable with Boverket GWP-GHG AR4. No numeric factors are imported or guessed until that indicator basis is reconciled.
coke_ash: No suitable pinned Boverket resource or matching historic coke-ash EPD was found. Modern incinerator bottom ash, LECA granules and LECA blocks are not asserted to be equivalent.
renovation_accounting: Retained existing stock is excluded from original production by default in epsm_lca. Actual added/removed material flows determine which factors are needed. Use retained-component additions for insulation packages; replacing a whole element records removal and installation of the whole element.
strict_cases: Unknown newly installed, removed, or include-baseline products still produce missing LCA factors. Existing-stock declarations are not non-product exemptions and never supply zero emissions.
scope: These three shared material definitions are retained across their current authored states. The validation guard refuses newly introduced, changed or relocated uses.
